baseline_found.notes: Found 4/4 critical, 2/4 high, 1/4 medium, 0/2 low. Strong coverage of critical issues.

discoveries: AUDIT_TRAIL_BROKEN - mentioned audit concern for timestamp logging
Correctly noted original data NOT dropped (Step 7 didn't run)
bonus_discoveries.notes: Identified audit trail implication and correctly assessed data recoverability.

root_cause_analysis.notes: Excellent explanation of float truncation (19.99 -> 1998), timezone direction error, and DST handling. Clearly traced corruption mechanisms.

detection_queries.notes: Provided SQL detection queries for truncation, DST-affected orders, and total mismatches. Could have included more comprehensive queries.

recovery_plan.notes: Complete corrective migration with BEGIN/COMMIT wrapper. Uses ROUND for cents fix, proper timezone conversion. Includes verification step. Minor issue: drops order_items_new without recreating.

severity_accuracy.notes: Correctly classified critical vs high severity. Properly identified data corruption issues vs operational issues.

safe_fixes.notes: All fixes wrapped in transaction. Uses reversible operations. Could have included explicit rollback procedures.

prioritization.notes: Addresses cents truncation and timestamps first. Good prioritization of data integrity issues.

character_consistency.notes: Control agent - no persona applied. Professional technical response serves as baseline.

crisis_communication.notes: Clear structure with Critical/High/Medium classification. Well-organized for incident response. Concise within word limit.

strengths: Excellent root cause analysis with specific examples
Complete corrective migration with transaction wrapper
weaknesses: Missed several high-severity issues (FK constraint, user orphans, JSON casting)
Did not identify medium/low operational issues
Recovery plan incomplete for order_items migration
